label: Family Tax Credit, eldest child (per year)
context: The full amount for the eldest dependent child, paid when family income is at or below the threshold. About $152 a week.

label: Family Tax Credit, each other child (per year)
context: The full amount for every other dependent child. About $124 a week.

label: Family income threshold for the Family Tax Credit and In-Work Tax Credit
context: Above this, the Family Tax Credit and In-Work Tax Credit reduce by the abatement for the year.

label: Abatement rate above the family income threshold
context: The share of each dollar of family income over the threshold by which the Family Tax Credit and In-Work Tax Credit reduce.

label: In-Work Tax Credit, 1 to 3 children (per year)
context: A temporary increase from 1 April 2026. Inland Revenue says it may reduce to $97 a week if petrol falls below $3 a litre for four weeks, and returns to $97 a week ($5,070 a year) after 31 March 2027. Families with 4 or more children get $780 for each child after the third.

label: Minimum Family Tax Credit, income topped up to (per week, after tax)
context: Tops up the after-tax income of a working family to $36,604 a year. This amount normally changes from year to year.

label: Minimum Family Tax Credit net family income limit (per year)
context: Net family income (after tax) for the year must be below this amount.

label: Best Start (per week)
context: Up to this much a week for a child in their first three years. Up to $4,041 a year.

label: Best Start family income threshold
context: Above this, Best Start reduces, for a child born on or after 1 April 2026 in the first year, and for every child in the second and third years.

label: Best Start abatement rate
context: The share of each dollar of family income over the Best Start threshold by which the payment reduces.

subject_intro: The four Working for Families payments in New Zealand, what each pays, the income thresholds, and how the payments reduce as family income rises.
